tooltips.annualRate: Annual growth rate in percent. Applied linearly or exponentially depending on the signal type.
tooltips.amplitude: Peak-to-peak oscillation range as percentage of the base value.
tooltips.period: Memory length of the filter in days. Higher values = smoother but slower response.
tooltips.offset: Vertical offset as percentage of the base value. Shifts the signal up or down.
tooltips.emaPeriod: Lookback window in sessions, the days with a quote. Maps to filter coefficient $\alpha = 2/(N+1)$. Shorter = faster reaction, longer = smoother.
tooltips.fastPeriod: Short-term EMA lookback for the MACD fast line. Standard: 12 sessions. Lower values react faster to price changes.
tooltips.slowPeriod: Long-term EMA lookback for the MACD slow line. Standard: 26 sessions. Higher values capture the broader trend.
tooltips.signalPeriod: EMA smoothing applied to the MACD line. Standard: 9 sessions. Reduces noise in crossover signals.
tooltips.multiplier: Number of standard deviations ($k \cdot \sigma$). $k=2$ covers ~95% of values assuming normal distribution.
tooltips.overbought: Level above which the asset is considered overbought. Standard: 70. Values near 100 indicate strong buying pressure.
tooltips.oversold: Level below which the asset is considered oversold. Standard: 30. Values near 0 indicate strong selling pressure.
tooltips.assetComparison: Select an asset to overlay its price on this chart. In percentage mode, both curves start at 0%.
tooltips.fxPair: Select an FX pair to overlay its exchange rate on this chart. In percentage mode, both curves start at 0%.
tooltips.sessionPeriod: Lookback window in sessions, the days with a quote. Higher values = smoother but slower response.

tooltips.stochRsiPeriod: RSI and stochastic lookback period. It changes %K and therefore also the derived %D line.
tooltips.dPeriod: Smoothing period applied to %K to produce %D. It changes %D only.
tooltips.riskWindow: Number of prepared daily return observations in each rolling window.

tooltips.comparisonAsset: Persisted asset used as the real comparison series for beta.
tooltips.riskFullHistory: Measure drawdown against the highest peak of the entire available history, not just the visible window. Disable for a faster, window-relative view.
